# Kosika Studio – Next Components Roadmap Below are eight high‑impact components that should be added to Kosika Studio. They are ordered by utility (most useful first) and include a brief description, justification, target page, affected source files, required Kosika Designs functions, and acceptance criteria. --- ## 1. Command Palette **What:** A searchable overlay (⌘ K / Ctrl K) that lets users run any Studio command, open files, or navigate pages. **Why:** Power users need a fast, keyboard‑first way to access functionality without leaving the keyboard. It speeds up workflows and mirrors the experience of modern IDEs. **Page:** Global – available on every page (header overlay). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add a container element (`
`). - `desktop/app/main.go` – expose a new endpoint `/cmd-palette` that returns the list of commands. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiOverlay`, `uiSearchBox`; `designs_palette.kos` – `paletteAccent`; `designs_motion.kos` – `fadeIn`, `slideDown`. **Done When:** The palette opens on the shortcut, filters commands as you type, and executing a command closes it. --- ## 2. Live Agents Panel **What:** A floating panel that shows each active AI agent with its pointer colour and a live preview of what it is typing. **Why:** When multiple agents collaborate, users need to see who is doing what in real‑time, preventing confusion. **Page:** Dashboard (`/dashboard`). **Changes:** - `desktop/README.md` – document the new UI component. - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add `
`. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiPanel`, `uiAvatar`; `designs_motion.kos` – `pulse`, `slideIn`. **Done When:** Each agent appears with a coloured cursor icon and a scrolling text preview that updates live. --- ## 3. Run Timeline **What:** A visual timeline that records each step of a run (e.g., prompts, responses, tool calls) with timestamps and status icons. **Why:** Users need to audit and debug complex runs; a timeline gives a clear, chronological view. **Page:** Run detail page (`/run/:id`). **Changes:** - `desktop/app/main.go` – add a new route `/run/:id/timeline` that returns JSON timeline data. - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – embed `
`. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiTimeline`, `uiBadge`; `designs_motion.kos` – `slideFade`. **Done When:** The timeline displays each step with time, type, and success/failure indicator, and expands/collapses details. --- ## 4. Diff Review Card **What:** A card that shows a diff between two versions of a text block with **Keep** and **Drop** actions. **Why:** Editing prompts or generated content often requires reviewing changes; a dedicated UI speeds this up. **Page:** Prompt editor (`/editor`). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – insert `
`. - `desktop/app/main.go` – provide an API `/diff` that returns a structured diff. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiCard`, `uiButton`; `designs_motion.kos` – `highlightFlash`. **Done When:** The card shows added/removed lines, and clicking **Keep** or **Drop** updates the underlying content accordingly. --- ## 5. Notifications System **What:** A toast‑style notification stack for success, error, and info messages. **Why:** Immediate feedback is essential for actions like saving, model switching, or errors. **Page:** Global (any page). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add `
`. - `desktop/app/main.go` – expose a WebSocket endpoint `/ws/notifications`. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiToast`; `designs_motion.kos` – `fadeSlide`. **Done When:** Notifications appear, auto‑dismiss after a configurable timeout, and are dismissible manually. --- ## 6. Model Picker **What:** A dropdown or modal that lets the user select which LLM model to use for the current session. **Why:** Different tasks benefit from different models; users should switch without leaving the page. **Page:** Settings (`/settings`) and editor toolbar. **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add ``. - `desktop/app/main.go` – endpoint `/models` returning available models; `/set-model` to persist choice. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiSelect`, `uiOption`; `designs_motion.kos` – `dropdownOpen`. **Done When:** The picker lists all models, the current selection persists across reloads, and changing it updates the session. --- ## 7. Session Exporter **What:** A button that bundles the current session (prompts, outputs, settings) into a downloadable JSON file. **Why:** Users need to backup, share, or migrate their work. **Page:** Session view (`/session/:id`). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add ``. - `desktop/app/main.go` – route `/session/:id/export` returning a JSON blob. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiButton`; `designs_motion.kos` – `pulse` on hover. **Done When:** Clicking the button triggers a file download named `session-.json` containing all relevant data. --- ## 8. Inline Help Tooltip **What:** Context‑aware tooltip that appears on hover/focus for UI elements, offering concise explanations. **Why:** Reduces onboarding friction and helps new users discover hidden features. **Page:** Everywhere – attached to elements via `data‑help="…"`. **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – include a global `
`. - `desktop/app/main.go` – optional endpoint `/help/:id` for dynamic content. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiTooltip`; `designs_motion.kos` – `fadeIn`. **Done When:** Hovering or focusing an element shows the tooltip positioned correctly, and it hides on mouseout/blur. --- *All component proposals reference the real files listed in the prompt and the actual design functions from the Kosika Designs library.*

events.result: - [ ] write a new file kosika/app_assets/studio_command_palette.kos: Kosika Studio's Command Palette (A searchable overlay (⌘ K / Ctrl K) that lets users run any Studio command, open files, or navigate pages.). Start it with import "std/designs_palette.kos"; export [command_palette_html]; command_palette_html(state: Text) -> Text gives a div of HTML with inline styles: background palette_named("dark_matter").panel, text colour .ink, a 1px border in .accent, rounded 10px; for state "empty" it holds the words "No command palette yet", for any other state the words "Command Palette" and the state; write no colour by hand; add tests that "empty" gives its words and the accent colour, and that "busy" contains "busy"

arguments.text:
# Kosika Studio – Next Components Roadmap Below are eight high‑impact components that should be added to Kosika Studio. They are ordered by utility (most useful first) and include a brief description, justification, target page, affected source files, required Kosika Designs functions, and acceptance criteria. --- ## 1. Command Palette **What:** A searchable overlay (⌘ K / Ctrl K) that lets users run any Studio command, open files, or navigate pages. **Why:** Power users need a fast, keyboard‑first way to access functionality without leaving the keyboard. It speeds up workflows and mirrors the experience of modern IDEs. **Page:** Global – available on every page (header overlay). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add a container element (`
`). - `desktop/app/main.go` – expose a new endpoint `/cmd-palette` that returns the list of commands. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiOverlay`, `uiSearchBox`; `designs_palette.kos` – `paletteAccent`; `designs_motion.kos` – `fadeIn`, `slideDown`. **Done When:** The palette opens on the shortcut, filters commands as you type, and executing a command closes it. --- ## 2. Live Agents Panel **What:** A floating panel that shows each active AI agent with its pointer colour and a live preview of what it is typing. **Why:** When multiple agents collaborate, users need to see who is doing what in real‑time, preventing confusion. **Page:** Dashboard (`/dashboard`). **Changes:** - `desktop/README.md` – document the new UI component. - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add `
`. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiPanel`, `uiAvatar`; `designs_motion.kos` – `pulse`, `slideIn`. **Done When:** Each agent appears with a coloured cursor icon and a scrolling text preview that updates live. --- ## 3. Run Timeline **What:** A visual timeline that records each step of a run (e.g., prompts, responses, tool calls) with timestamps and status icons. **Why:** Users need to audit and debug complex runs; a timeline gives a clear, chronological view. **Page:** Run detail page (`/run/:id`). **Changes:** - `desktop/app/main.go` – add a new route `/run/:id/timeline` that returns JSON timeline data. - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – embed `
`. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiTimeline`, `uiBadge`; `designs_motion.kos` – `slideFade`. **Done When:** The timeline displays each step with time, type, and success/failure indicator, and expands/collapses details. --- ## 4. Diff Review Card **What:** A card that shows a diff between two versions of a text block with **Keep** and **Drop** actions. **Why:** Editing prompts or generated content often requires reviewing changes; a dedicated UI speeds this up. **Page:** Prompt editor (`/editor`). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – insert `
`. - `desktop/app/main.go` – provide an API `/diff` that returns a structured diff. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiCard`, `uiButton`; `designs_motion.kos` – `highlightFlash`. **Done When:** The card shows added/removed lines, and clicking **Keep** or **Drop** updates the underlying content accordingly. --- ## 5. Notifications System **What:** A toast‑style notification stack for success, error, and info messages. **Why:** Immediate feedback is essential for actions like saving, model switching, or errors. **Page:** Global (any page). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add `
`. - `desktop/app/main.go` – expose a WebSocket endpoint `/ws/notifications`. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiToast`; `designs_motion.kos` – `fadeSlide`. **Done When:** Notifications appear, auto‑dismiss after a configurable timeout, and are dismissible manually. --- ## 6. Model Picker **What:** A dropdown or modal that lets the user select which LLM model to use for the current session. **Why:** Different tasks benefit from different models; users should switch without leaving the page. **Page:** Settings (`/settings`) and editor toolbar. **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add ``. - `desktop/app/main.go` – endpoint `/models` returning available models; `/set-model` to persist choice. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiSelect`, `uiOption`; `designs_motion.kos` – `dropdownOpen`. **Done When:** The picker lists all models, the current selection persists across reloads, and changing it updates the session. --- ## 7. Session Exporter **What:** A button that bundles the current session (prompts, outputs, settings) into a downloadable JSON file. **Why:** Users need to backup, share, or migrate their work. **Page:** Session view (`/session/:id`). **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – add ``. - `desktop/app/main.go` – route `/session/:id/export` returning a JSON blob. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiButton`; `designs_motion.kos` – `pulse` on hover. **Done When:** Clicking the button triggers a file download named `session-.json` containing all relevant data. --- ## 8. Inline Help Tooltip **What:** Context‑aware tooltip that appears on hover/focus for UI elements, offering concise explanations. **Why:** Reduces onboarding friction and helps new users discover hidden features. **Page:** Everywhere – attached to elements via `data‑help="…"`. **Changes:** - `kosika/app_assets/index.html` – include a global `
`. - `desktop/app/main.go` – optional endpoint `/help/:id` for dynamic content. **Design Functions:** `designs_ui.kos` – `uiTooltip`; `designs_motion.kos` – `fadeIn`. **Done When:** Hovering or focusing an element shows the tooltip positioned correctly, and it hides on mouseout/blur. --- *All component proposals reference the real files listed in the prompt and the actual design functions from the Kosika Designs library.*
